data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding (claims reserves) at 1 January 2015 per the balance sheet prior-year column is GBP 48.51m. The report does not provide a clearly labelled gross 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' figure that can be extracted unambiguously from the available pages, so no gross prior-year development amount is reported here. Gross written premium for the year is GBP 83.398m with the principal classes being Accident and health, Property, Energy and Motor.
data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet (Liabilities - Claims outstanding) 2014 comparative column (page 15). No explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' or a gross prior-year development number could be located on the scanned pages; therefore prior_year_development is null. Gross premium mix and totals transcribed from the 'Gross written premium by class of business' table (page 5); amounts are from the 2015 column and converted to millions. Extraction is based on low-resolution images and some numeric transcription required interpretation; confidence flags indicate this.
